guardrail: Store adjudicated endpoint grades and their source/version. CART-TRACE does not infer clinical toxicity grades from isolated measurements.

crs.name: cytokine release syndrome
crs.source: Lee DW et al. Biol Blood Marrow Transplant. 2019;25(4):625-638. doi:10.1016/j.bbmt.2018.12.758
crs.notes: ASTCT CRS grading is driven by fever at onset and the severity of hypotension and/or hypoxia; biomarkers alone do not define grade.

icans.name: immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome
icans.source: Lee DW et al. Biol Blood Marrow Transplant. 2019;25(4):625-638. doi:10.1016/j.bbmt.2018.12.758
icans.notes: ASTCT ICANS grading depends on the most severe applicable neurologic domain; the repository stores domain observations separately from adjudicated grade.

response.name: disease response
response.notes: Response criteria are disease-specific and must not be mixed across indications without an explicit harmonization rule.
